detailed_description: Aspect Ratio Calculator is a small browser-side helper for finding and applying simple width-to-height ratios. Enter the original width and height as numbers, and the tool shows the simplified ratio (such as 16:9) computed locally. Six common preset buttons (1:1, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 21:9, 9:16) fill both the original and the new dimensions when clicked. In the resize section enter a new width or new height; with Lock Ratio enabled, the other value updates to keep the same ratio as the original dimensions. The result panel shows the final width x height with a Copy button. It does not import images or videos, read EXIF metadata, support physical units like inches, run through a Calculate button, or export reports.
usage_steps: Enter the original width and height as numbers
Read the simplified ratio shown in the highlighted display
Optionally click a common ratio preset (1:1, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 21:9, 9:16) to fill both sets of dimensions
Tick or untick Lock Ratio to control whether the other new dimension follows automatically
Type a new width or new height; with Lock Ratio on, the other value adjusts to match the original ratio
Click Copy to copy the resulting width x height string
usage_examples: Find that 1920x1080 simplifies to 16:9 and copy a downscaled 1280x720 value
Pick the 4:3 preset and type a new width to read the matching new height
Lock the ratio of an existing thumbnail size and try a few new widths to see the corresponding heights
Copy the resulting width x height string into a layout note or CSS comment
